subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: findSingletonEntry destructures { contentTypeUid, lang, referenceFieldPath, jsonRtePath, only, except, where } from IContentstackGetSingletonEntry but does NOT destructure or forward live_preview to createContentTypeQuery. Since IContentstackGetSingletonEntry extends ICommonContentstackConfig (which now has live_preview), callers can pass live_preview but it is silently dropped. This means linked/tabular references fetched via findSingletonEntry will not show draft values, partially undermining the story's core goal of 'linked/tabular references show draft values'. findSingletonEntry is used in urlRewritesService and pageService for fetching page content with referenceFieldPath — exactly the content that needs draft preview.
issues.suggestedFix: Add live_preview to the destructured params of findSingletonEntry and pass it to createContentTypeQuery: createContentTypeQuery({ contentTypeUid, referenceFieldPath, only, except, where, lang, limit: 1, live_preview }). Add a corresponding unit test verifying addParam is called with the preview_hash.

issues.description: getSingletonEntry has the same gap as findSingletonEntry — it destructures { contentTypeUid, lang, referenceFieldPath, jsonRtePath, only, except, where } but does NOT destructure or forward live_preview to createContentTypeQuery. Draft preview context is silently dropped for this code path. getSingletonEntry is the most widely used query function in the codebase (pageService, stationService, userAccountService, 404/maintenance pages, find-a-station pages) — all these content paths will fail to show draft preview values.
issues.suggestedFix: Add live_preview to the destructured params of getSingletonEntry and pass it to createContentTypeQuery: createContentTypeQuery({ contentTypeUid, referenceFieldPath, only, except, where, lang, live_preview }). Add a corresponding unit test verifying addParam is called with the preview_hash.
